title: dynamic-user-interface.html
content: Important Configuration Step If you are an existing Blackthorn customer, you need to add the “Dynamic” value to the Event's {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} field's picklist. The “Dynamic” picklist value will be added automatically for new installations. To add the “Dynamic” value to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} field's picklist, complete the steps below. Click the Gear icon in the upper right-hand corner. Click Setup . Click the Object Manager tab. Search for and click “Event”. Click Fields & Relationships. Search for and click “UI Experience”. In the Values section, click {{variable.button_new}} . Add “Dynamic”. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . What is Supported by Each User Interface? The following chart shows the features we currently support for each {{glossary.user interface (UI)}} . {{snippet.EV_Table_SupportedEachUI}} UI Experience Field Setup {{snippet.EV_UIExperienceSetup}} Functionality Accessibility {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can change the accessibility options (Virtual Keyboard, Accessible Mode, Content Adjustments, Color & Display Adjustments, and Navigation Adjustments) on the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page. Contact Us Form When an individual sends an email from the Contact Us {{variable.Object_BTForm}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page and the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} is set to “Dynamic UI”, the subject line on the email received by the Event Planner will include both the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} and the {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTemp_Subject}} from the Contact Us {{variable.Object_BTForm}} . On the {{variable.Object_Event}} page, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can click the Contact Us tab and go to the Contact Us section. There, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can fill out the Contact Us {{variable.Object_BTForm}} and send the message to a previously defined person. Content {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can navigate through the content on the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} does not have any related {{variable.Object_EventContent}} records, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not see the Content tab on the navigation bar. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} has {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomTabs}} = “Hide” then the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can not see the Content tab on the navigation bar. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} has at least one related {{variable.Object_EventContent}} record, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see and can click the Content tab on the navigation bar. After clicking the Content tab on the navigation bar, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see the content defined for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , including the name ( {{variable.Field_EventContent_ContentName}} field), description ( {{variable.Field_EventContent_Description}} field), and content link ( {{variable.Field_EventContent_URL}} field). An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can see an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s downloadable Content files in the “Downloadable Content” section on the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page. The files will be listed in descending alphabetical order. Clicking the Download button will cause a new browser tab to open with the URL related to the file. To make a file description appear, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will need to perform one of the following tasks. Desktop: hover over a file name Mobile Device: tap the file name Dates The Date format in Dynamic UI follows the same logic and pattern as the Full-Width UI. (Ex. Wednesday, April 6, 2022, 9:00 AM to Friday, June 30, 2023, 9:00 AM ET) The logic for the date fields in the Dynamic UI is the same as the logic in the Full-width UI. The “to” that joins the start and end dates is the label: LBL_DATE_CONJUNCTION_TO, which can be updated to a different value such as a hyphen. If {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_HideTimezon}} = “True” on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} , the time zone will not be displayed. If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} is the same as the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} or the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} is blank, the format will change to Wednesday, April 6, 2022, 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM ET. If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndTime}} are blank, the format will change to Wednesday, April 6, 2022, 9:00 AM. If a value is selected for the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DateFormat}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} , that format will override the [weekday], [month] [day], and [year] portion of the date formatting. Event Items Tickets If an {{variable.Object_Event}} has either more than one {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} option or at least one paid {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see the Buy Ticket button in the navigation bar. After clicking the button, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to purchase {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} s. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} has either more than one {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} option or at least one paid {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can click the Ticket tab in the navigation bar to see the available {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} s. If there are more than three {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} s available, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can click View All Tickets to see all of the {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} s. Each {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} will include the following information: Name ( {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} ) Type ( {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} ) Description ( {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}} ) Price ( {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} ) If the {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} is a paid {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see a Buy Ticket button. If the {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} is a free {{variable.Object_EventItem_Ticket}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see a {{variable.Button_GetTicket}} button. Clicking either button will start the Checkout process for the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . Products When creating a {{variable.Object_EventItem_Product}} , an Event Planner can enter a value in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} , {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MinQuantity}} , and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} fields. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for an {{variable.Object_Event}} with {{variable.Object_EventItem_Product}} s available for purchase, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can use the quantity selector to add multiples of a {{variable.Object_EventItem_Product}} to their cart. Event Page Hero Section On the Event Page, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the following {{variable.Object_Event}} information in the {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_HeroSection}} . Banner Image ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} ) The recommended image size is 2500 x 731px, with a minimum of 1100 x 321px. For all other UIs, the recommended image size is 820 x 410, with a minimum of 650 x 320px. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} Location ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCity}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCountry}} ) Dates/Times ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartTime}} , and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndTime}} ) {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Description}} Featured Sponsors Buy Ticket button Navigation Labels that are too long to fit across the top navigation bar are accessible via slider arrows. Slider arrows are NOT visible when the labels fit across the top navigation bar. The registration/call-to-action button is always visible and is not included in the slider functionality. Display Density Event Organizers can use the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_EV_DefaultDisplayDensity}} (conference360__Default_Display_Density__c) field to change how an {{variable.Object_Event}} with {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} = “Dynamic” appears on the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage. If {{variable.Field_EV_DefaultDisplayDensity}} = “Hide” (the default setting), the toggle button will not be visible on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} ). If {{variable.Field_EV_DefaultDisplayDensity}} = “Comfy,” the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} ) will load with the existing look and feel. If {{variable.Field_EV_DefaultDisplayDensity}} = “Compact,” the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} ) will load with reduced whitespace and a shortened page length. Event Settings Four pairs of fields were added to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record to customize the label and URL of each visible link in the footer of a related {{variable.Object_Event}} . All related permission sets were updated to include the new fields.  The custom URL fields only accept domains (i.e., www, google, or com). Domain paths do not work. Custom labels will not be visible if the corresponding URL field is empty. {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustoLabel1}} - Text (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomURL1}} - URL (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustoLabel2}} - Text (255) {{variable. Field_ETETSettings_CustoURL2}} - URL (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustoLabel3}} - Text (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomURL3}} - URL (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustoLabel4}} - Text (255) {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomURL4}} - URL (255) Frequently Asked Questions An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can now see the FAQs tab in the navigation bar on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. Clicking the tab will take the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to the {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_FAQs}} section. Clicking a specific question will show all information related to that question. The Event Admin defines the questions/answers in the {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_FAQs}} section during the {{variable.Object_Event}} setup process. The background color for the Speaker and FAQ sections will match the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_BkgrndColor}} value in the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . NOTE: The FAQ gradient overlay will still be in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_PrimaryColo}} . Language Selector If the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_LangSelecto}} on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} is enabled, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} button/dropdown on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can then choose the language they would like the content translated into. Mobile Devices {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can now navigate an {{variable.Object_Event}} page on a mobile device from the bottom navigation bar. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} on a mobile device clicks anywhere on a {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} logo, the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} page will open to show information about the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} . Once the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} closes the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} ’s page, they will be returned to the section of the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page they were previously viewing. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} on a mobile device selects a {{variable.Object_Session}} from the {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_FeaturedSessio}} or {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_AllSessions}} section, they will see the following. Image ( {{variable.Field_Session_ImageURL}} ) {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}} Session {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} , {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} , {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}} , or {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}}   {{variable.Field_Session_Description}} {{variable.Object_SessionSpeaker}} s Once the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} closes the {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s page, they will be returned to the section of the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page they were previously viewing. Mobile Device: The UI for Simple {{variable.Object_Event}} s matches the existing design for complex {{variable.Object_Event}} s, except for the order of components. The new order is as follows. Banner image Title Location Dates Description Registration Form {{variable.Button_Register}} button Thumbnail Images Users can also show secondary thumbnail/banner images for {{variable.Object_Event}} s with the correct aspect ratio in an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} on a mobile device by using the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} field. This is especially helpful for {{variable.Object_Event}} s using the Dynamic UI since the Dynamic UI uses a different image ratio for Banners, which results in cropped thumbnails on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} webpages.  Available Banner and Thumbnail Fields  Banner: {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} (Image_URL__c) and {{variable.Field_EV_ImageName}} (Image_Name__c)  Thumbnail: {{variable.Object_Event}} 's {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} (Thumbnail_and_Mobile_Image_URL__c) and {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailImageName}} (Thumbnail_Image_Name__c) Navigation The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can see an {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page’s footer. The footer includes the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_LogoUrl}} and up to four customizable links. When a user navigates from the {{variable.Label_EventPageBuilder}} section to the {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_GeneralInfo}} page to update the {{variable.Object_Event}} 's dates and time and navigates back to the {{variable.Label_EventPageBuilder}} section, they will see the updated information in the {{variable.Label_EventPageBuilder}} {{variable.Label_EVBuilder_HeroSection}} . Sessions When an {{variable.Object_Event}} has at least one {{variable.Object_Session}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can see the Schedule tab on the navigation bar and go to the Schedule section. When an {{variable.Object_Event}} has no {{variable.Object_Session}} s, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} cannot see the Schedule tab on the navigation bar. When an {{variable.Object_Event}} has at least one {{variable.Object_Session}} AND the Admin/Planner has hidden this section, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not be able to see the Schedule tab on the navigation bar. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} does not include any {{variable.Object_Session}} s, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will not see the Sessions tab on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} has {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sessions}} set to “Hide”, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will not see the Sessions tab on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} includes {{variable.Object_Session}} s, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see two Featured Sessions on the Sessions tab. Each Featured Session can include the following information. {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}} Image ( {{variable.Field_Session_ImageURL}} ) Schedule {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} , {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} , {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}} , or {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} ) {{variable.Field_Session_Description}} {{variable.Object_Keyword}} s {{variable.Object_Speaker}} (s) {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} (s) {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can use the View All / Collapse buttons to view/hide the list of {{variable.Object_Session}} s.  When an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} = “Dynamic,” a {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s start and end times will appear as follows.  If a {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} and {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} fields are populated, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will only see the {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s start/end time range.  If a {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} and {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} fields are populated, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will only see the start date and time.  If a {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} field is populated, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will only see the start date.  If a {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} field is populated but the {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} field is blank, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will not see a start/end time range. Simple Events If an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} views a simple {{variable.Object_Event}} on a desktop and the {{variable.Object_Event}} does not include any {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s, {{variable.Object_EventContent}} , FAQs, or {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not see the navigation bar at the top of the page. If the simple {{variable.Object_Event}} includes {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s, {{variable.Object_EventContent}} , FAQs, or {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s, the navigation bar will be visible. The user interface for Simple Events now reflects the new Dynamic UI with updates to colors, placement, size, and spacing. The image is a banner across the top of the page with dimensions matching the complex {{variable.Object_Event}} design. The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} , location, dates, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Description}} are in a column on the left side. The Registration Form and the Register button are in a column on the right side. Speakers When there are no {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , the Speakers tab will not be visible. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Speakers}} field = “Hide”, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not be able to see the Speakers tab on the navigation bar. When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Speakers tab in the navigation bar, they will be taken to the Speakers’ section. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see four {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s per row and the View All button. The {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s will be ordered by featured Speaker(s) and then by full name. Each {{variable.Object_Speaker}} will include the following information: Image ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_ImageURL}} ) Name ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_FirstName}} {{variable.Field_Speaker_LastName}} ) Organization ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Company}} ) Position ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Title}} ) Description ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Bio}} ) When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks on a {{variable.Object_Speaker}} , the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see the following information about the {{variable.Object_Speaker}} : Image ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_ImageURL}} ) Name ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_FirstName}} {{variable.Field_Speaker_LastName}} ) Organization ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Company}} ) Position ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Title}} ) Description ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Bio}} ) Social media links ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Instagram}} , {{variable.Field_Speaker_LinkedIn}} , and {{variable.Field_Speaker_Twitter}} ) {{variable.Object_Session}} s where the {{variable.Object_Speaker}} is scheduled. If the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the View All button and wants to close the expanded list, they can click the Collapse button. The background color for Speaker and FAQ sections will match the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_BkgrndColor}} value in the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} . NOTE: The FAQ gradient overlay will still be in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_PrimaryColo}} . Sponsors When there are no {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , the Sponsors tab will not be visible. If the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sponsors}} field = “Hide”, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not be able to see the Sponsors tab on the navigation bar. When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Sponsors tab in the navigation bar, they will be taken to the Sponsors’ section. The {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s will be grouped by Tier. When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} hovers over a {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} ’s logo/image, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see the following information: Logo ( {{variable.Field_Sponsor_ImageURL}} ) Name ( {{variable.Field_Sponsor_DisplayName}} ) Level ( {{variable.Field_Sponsor_Tier}} ) {{variable.Field_Sponsor_Description}} If an image/logo isn’t uploaded for the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} , then only the text will be visible. UI Experience If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} = “Master” and a free {{variable.Object_Event}} has one {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and no {{variable.Object_Session}} s, the user will only see a single registration form. References to {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s and {{variable.Object_Session}} s in the navigation will not be visible. If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} = “Master” and an {{variable.Object_Event}} has multiple {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s and {{variable.Object_Session}} s, the user will not see the single registration form. Venues If the Venue section for an {{variable.Object_Event}} page is enabled, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to see the Venue tab, click the tab, and see a map with a card that shows the address and two buttons ( Get Directions and View Large Map ).
